name: Traditional Caldo de Pollo (Mexican Chicken Soup with Rice & Peeled Zucchini)
whyItWorks: Rich, deeply nourishing chicken soup simmered with bone-in poultry, white rice, peeled zucchini (calabacitas), and tender peeled carrots. Exceptionally hydrating and restorative during flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Caldo de Pollo—con arroz y calabacitas; please leave out the cabbage wedge, corn on the cob, and raw onion garnish.' Sip broth warm.
